{container=~".*(database|server|task|git|cache).*", container!~".*run.*", container=~"$container" , level=~"(?i)ERR.*|CRIT|FATAL.*"}| line_format "{{__timestamp__ | date `2006-01-02 15:04:05.00` }}\t{{.container| replace `infrahub-` ``}}\t{{.level}}\t{{.logger}}\t{{.message}}"
